description: Test suite for BoringSSL's rand_extra module, including tests for RAND_bytes, forking behavior, threading, and RDRAND instruction support.

methods.name: NotObviouslyBroken
methods.description: Test that RAND_bytes produces different outputs and non-zero data.

methods.name: Fork
methods.description: Test forking behavior of RAND_bytes, ensuring different outputs from parent and child processes.

methods.name: RunConcurrentRands
methods.description: Run multiple threads calling RAND_bytes concurrently to test thread safety.

methods.name: Threads
methods.description: Test concurrent RAND_bytes calls across multiple threads.

methods.name: RdrandABI
methods.description: Test for RDRAND instruction support and ABI compliance.
